value: Futa focus RPG with a huge amount of giant futa femdom scenarios using koikatsu renders. Contains semi-linear battle encounters with comically over-the-top choreographies. Uses AI-generated music.

A thief from another world leaves a valuable artifact in your possession, leading you to be captured in a tower guarded by giant futa girls, where you are relentlessly hunted by the floor guardians to retrieve the artifact. Time to Complete: >5 hours

Explore a giant prison tower filled with giant futa girls. Battle giant women by using the appropriate elemental attack. At various enemy health increments animated sequences play where your character is dominated during battle. (Game balance falls apart after learning a “Full Shield” ability, making the game more of a scene viewer game)
